title: GUARD (fixed in f799727619) — was: _complete_help attributes every tag to one caller too many: zshrs adds `_normal`

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): `_complete_help` credited every tag to `_normal`, and `_describe` ignored EXTENDED_GLOB
retired.why: Two defects, both fixed there. (1) The recorded note blamed a missing $funcstack frame; that was real but NOT what printed `_normal`. Base/Widget/_complete_help sh:84 builds `$f` with "${${(@)…funcstack[3,(i)_(main_complete|complete|approximate|normal)]…}% *}": the outer expansion has no (@), so the words are joined and `% *` drops the LAST word, the frame the (i) subscript stopped on. The port (derive_responsible_func) stripped each element instead and kept `_normal` in every caller list. With only (2) applied the grid still showed `_normal` on all four rows. (2) A self-calling definition file (`_complete_help() {…}` … `_complete_help "$@"`) runs two `_complete_help` frames on its first autoload (c:Src/exec.c:5823 doshfunc -> loadautofn c:5735); the port ran one. compsys::router::run_port adds that frame once per name, which is what the variant's FS: line measures.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand with scripts/compsys_regressions.py --only complete_help_caller_frame --variants: on the fixed binary the unflipped fixture scored NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES for the cell and variant0 alike, and the runner reported the binary MOVED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> 7bbe77b1d2005663), the "somebody fixed the bug" branch. With expect flipped to agrees, three runs scored 2 CONTROL-HOLDS each (cell + variant0). A direct two-TAB probe (comptab_screen.py, bindkey ^I _complete_help, completer logging $funcstack) printed identical grids and identical FS lines on both shells: `_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help|_complete_help` on the first TAB, one `_complete_help` on the second.

observed.measured: 2026-09-15, fix commit f799727619, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from the shared tree carrying that change (zshrs 0.12.64, 113752400 bytes, sha256 7bbe77b1d2005663) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: both shells print `argument-1  (_arguments _fzc0001)` and `globbed-files`/`directories`/`all-files  (_files _arguments _fzc0001)`; zshrs no longer appends `_normal`.

observed_when_diverging.notes: The parenthesised list after each tag is the caller chain _complete_help prints; zshrs appends `_normal` to all four. The cause is one frame short in $funcstack under this widget, measured directly by the variant below: zsh `_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help|_complete_help`, zshrs the same minus the trailing `_complete_help`. _complete_help slices $funcstack with ${a[3,(i)_(main_complete|complete_help)]}; that subscript evaluated on a literal array is byte-identical on both shells, so what is pinned here is the funcstack CONTENT, not the subscript.
observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: commit 3b4a01f0cd, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.12.49 sha256 6420c23cecc13c35 (the confirmed stamp this retirement moves into history)

variants.note: the funcstack itself, displayed by the completer with `zle -M` before it runs: zsh emits `FS:_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help|_complete_help`, zshrs `FS:_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help` — one frame short. The message is overwritten on the settled grid, so it is the RAW STREAM that carries it; the grid still fails on the same four caller-attribution rows.
